labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Usage question: how to strip markup from a string. Documented via Text.from_markup().plain.

items.body:
To get the plain text of a string with markup removed, parse it with `Text.from_markup()` and read `.plain`:

```python
from rich.text import Text

Text.from_markup("[bold red]Apple[/] pie").plain  # "Apple pie"
```

Match your search against that plain text. The markup syntax is described in [markup.rst](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/markup.rst). A related earlier question about stripping styles is #2016.

For usage questions, [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) is the right place.
